not_used.tile_size: it tiles the image itself; see 'OrthoSAM's own tile size' under More settings.
not_used.overlap: it tiles the image itself; see 'Overlap of OrthoSAM's own tiles' under More settings.
not_used.confidence: it gives no per-grain confidence; every grain is scored 1.
not_used.dedup: it merges the grains of its own tiles and passes itself.

settings.label: Resample factor of the first pass
settings.help: Enlarges the image before the first pass. Higher: finer grains found; 2 means four times the pixels.

settings.label: Coarser pass for large grains
settings.help: A second look at a smaller copy, where large grains become whole. None: faster, large grains may be split.

authors.source: OrthoSAM large_orthosam preset: a later pass at 0.5

settings.label: Minimum grain area
settings.help: Smaller grains are dropped. Higher: fewer specks.

authors.source: no value in pixels: the large_orthosam preset's expected_min_size is 30 mm² on the ground, which depends on the image's resolution

settings.differs_because: PebbleMapper gives OrthoSAM sizes in pixels and keeps the preset's number, 30, as an area in pixels.

settings.label: Prompt points per tile side
settings.help: Prompt points along each tile side. Higher: more small grains, much more graphics memory.

settings.label: Stability threshold
settings.help: Masks less stable than this are dropped. Higher: fewer, cleaner grains.

settings.label: OrthoSAM's own tile size
settings.help: The side of OrthoSAM's tiles. Higher: more context per tile, more graphics memory.

settings.label: Overlap of OrthoSAM's own tiles
settings.help: How much OrthoSAM's tiles overlap. Higher: fewer grains cut at tile seams, slower.

settings.label: Mask dilation
settings.help: Grows each mask before the tiles are merged. Higher: larger outlines.

fixed.label: Segment Anything model
fixed.reason: the authors' configuration uses vit_h, which needs much more graphics memory and a 2.5 GB download; this release ships vit_b only.

fixed.label: Image preprocessing
fixed.reason: OrthoSAM's optional blurring and contrast steps are off, as in its authors' preset.

fixed.label: Masks at tile edges
fixed.reason: masks touching the edge of an OrthoSAM tile are removed and recovered from the overlapping tiles, as in the authors' setup.
